finalText:
All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `RD-1015` titled "fwrd85-n1 RD Bench Ticket" created (customer "Bench Works Ltd", created 2026-09-23). Only field required by the New ticket form was Title (Customer was optional).

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part "fwrd85-n1 RD Part A" added with cost 100, markup 25, qty 1. App-computed price: **$125.00** (ticket total at that point: $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part "fwrd85-n1 RD Part B" added with cost 200, markup 25, qty 1. App-computed price: **$250.00** (ticket total then: $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup 25, qty 1 unchanged). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (ticket total then: $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: clicking "Mark Ready" was initially refused with an inline alert headed **"Ticket is not ready"** listing two reasons: `Part "fwrd85-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier` and `Part "fwrd85-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier`. **What was required: every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** I set Supplier = "Acme Parts" on both parts (all other values unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded — the alert disappeared, the status read "Ready", and the button swapped to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed". No separate success toast was shown.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via a Confirm dialog accepted with "Delete part"; total went $437.50 → $250.00 → empty, table showing "No parts on this ticket yet."). Then "Archive ticket" clicked on the detail page — no confirmation dialog appeared; the page showed Status "Ready" with an "Archived" badge and the button became "Unarchive ticket". Verified: with "Show archived" unchecked, searching "fwrd85" returns "No tickets match the current filters." and the active list is back to 13 tickets with no fwrd85-n1 rows; with "Show archived" checked, the only match is `RD-1015 | fwrd85-n1 RD Bench Ticket (Archived) | Bench Works Ltd | Ready | 0 parts | 2026-09-23`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
